function debounce<F extends (...a: any[]) => void>(f: F) {
  return (...a: Parameters<F>) => f(...a);
}
debounce((n: number) => console.log(n))(1);

function describe<F extends (...a: any[]) => void>(args: Parameters<F>): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const arg of args) parts.push(String(arg));
  return `${args.length}: ${args.map(String).join(",")} ${[...args][0]} ${parts.join("/")}`;
}
console.log(describe<(a: number, b: string) => void>([1, "x"]));

class Box {
  constructor(public value: number, public label: string) {}
}
function make<T extends new (...a: any[]) => Box>(c: T, args: ConstructorParameters<T>): Box {
  return new c(...args);
}
console.log(make(Box, [2, "two"]).label);

type Tail<T> = T extends [unknown, ...rest: infer R] ? R : never;
function tailLength<T extends unknown[]>(rest: Tail<T>): number {
  return rest.length;
}
console.log(tailLength<[number, string, boolean]>(["a", true]));
